# Character enrichment sources

These optional, unreviewed annotations were supplied in the character-enrichment
handoff. The original canonical catalogue remains separate and unchanged.

- Make Me a Hanzi dictionary, commit bddc96d41bef78427ed0e034e9f7e31d71fd1b92:
  LGPL-3.0-or-later. Corresponding dictionary source and licence notices are in
  `notices/`. Source: https://github.com/skishore/makemeahanzi/tree/bddc96d41bef78427ed0e034e9f7e31d71fd1b92
- Hanzi Writer Data 2.0.1: Arphic Public License. Geometry is fetched on demand
  from the version-pinned package, not replaced by standalone components.
  Notice: `notices/STROKE_DATA_ARPHICPL.txt`.
- BabelStone IDS, 2025-06-27 / Unicode 16.0: source comparisons retain their
  regional qualifiers. The supplied manifest records permission evidence, not
  an independently established licence for all underlying characters. No full
  BabelStone snapshot is redistributed here. Source: https://www.babelstone.co.uk/CJK/IDS.TXT
- GF 0014-2009: eight bounded textual rule-example annotations only. No PDF,
  font artwork, table artwork or complete standard component inventory is
  redistributed. Source: https://www.unicode.org/irg/docs/n2739-GF0014-2009.pdf

`manifest.json` retains the supplied source versions, hashes, consumer policy,
licence-notice references and coverage. Original generator/audit utilities and
all their inputs were not provided; the local split adapter is not a substitute
for rerunning that upstream audit. Exact source agreement and complete stroke
coverage do not establish editorial approval, etymology or verified stroke names.

entries.text: 屈# bend + 土 earth → bend to dig (compare 掘) → *ditch* → *moat*.
突也。《詩》曰：“蜉蝣堀閱。”从土，屈省聲。
兔堀也。从土屈聲。

As per 尚# (rise → raise) + 土 earth → raise a *tall earthen platform* (object stretching high in the sky) → *palace*; *hall* (← constructions built on a platform) → *temple*; *shrine*; *capacious building*.
殿也。从土尚聲。
As per 臤# (adhere) + 土 earth → tightly adhering earth → *hard*; *solid*; *firm* → *serious*; *formal*.
剛也。从臤从土。
As per 隹# (exert downward pressure) + 土 earth → tall, heavy pile of earth → *pile up*.
黏土也。从土，从黃省。凡堇之屬皆从堇。
As per 亞# (downward pressure) + 土 earth → mud/soft earth pressed down on construction materials in plastering → *clay*; *plaster*; *coat* (v.).
白涂也。从土亞聲。
As per 朋# (spread in alignment) + 土 earth → (object created of) earth that is spread in alignment → *cover with earth*; *bury*. Also, an *earthen dam*.
喪葬下土也。从土朋聲。《春秋傳》曰：“朝而堋。”《禮》謂之封，《周官》謂之窆。《虞書》曰：“堋淫于家。”
凷也。从土畐聲。
咼# (variant of 冎 cavity) + 土 earth → rounded earthenware vessel used to process metal → *melting pot*; *crucible*.
As per 侯# (lumpy object) + 土 earth → *raised earth* (or *earthen structure*). Also, *mileposts* (← raised earth).
As per 保# (cover) + 土 earth → *fort* or *fortress* covering a large swath of earth.
堣夷，在冀州陽谷。立春日，日值之而出。从土禺聲。《尚書》曰：“宅堣夷。”
As per 是# (straight) + 土 earth → straight earthen *embankment* → *bank*; *levee*; *dike*.
滯也。从土是聲。
壁間隙也。从土曷聲。讀若謁。
甚# extreme + 土 earth → *endure* extreme pressure exerted by an earthen construction → *bear*; *(with)stand* → *fitting* (← fit to endure pressure).
地突也。从土甚聲。
穜也。一曰内其中也。从土㚇聲。

The relevant oracle bone form of this character shows 人 person + a depiction of a tall, arching pile of goods → carry goods piled high upon the back. A seal inscription form replaces the objects on top with a large pile of earth → arch (extremely) *high*.
高也。从垚在兀上，高遠也。
As per 匽# (set in place) + 土 earth → pack earth and set in place to create a *dam* → *dam up*.

As per 𠬝# as described in 服 (spread over) + 幸 (handcuffs) → spread a restraining device over part of a criminal's body in *retribution* for a crime → *retaliation*; *recompense*; *remunerate* → *reward*. Also, *report* and *announce* (← report/announce punitive measures taken ).
當罪人也。从㚔从𠬝。𠬝，服罪也。
昜# rise + 土 earth → public space on high ground → *public square/plaza*; *place/location* → *scene*; *session* (played out in public).
祭神道也。一曰田不耕。一曰治穀田也。从土昜聲。
As per 者# (pile) + 土 earth → piled earth forming a *wall* → *prevent*; *stop* → *stop up*.
垣也。五版爲一堵。从土者聲。
界# boundary/border + 土 earth (for emphasis/clarification) → territorial *boundary*.
屏 wall + 土 earth → earthen *wall* → *fence*.
As per 脊# (jagged) + 土 earth → rocky (= jagged), *barren soil*.
As per 鬼# (large and lumpy) + 土 earth → large *lump/clod* of earth (compare 圣 as described in 怪, as well as 顆) → *cluster*; *group*.
As per 𤇾# as described in 榮 (curve about) + 土 earth → *cemetery* (← parcel of encircled land).
墓也。从土，熒省聲。
The right-hand element# described in 榻 (press flat) + 土 earth → collapsed/flattened pile of earth → *collapse*. Compare 圮.
稻中畦也。从土朕聲。
As per 豈# (pile) + 土 earth → *highland*.
高燥也。从土豈聲。
As per 朔# (conjunction of beginning and end points) + 土 earth → *clay figure*; *model* (that returns to clay when destroyed).
時# time; season + 土 earth → earthen *coop/roost* (← from which roosters crow to signal the beginning of a day).
雞棲垣爲塒。从土時聲。
塗也。从土冥聲。
荅# (press/fit together) + 土 earth → stupa built with one layer pressed upon another → *tower*.
西域浮屠也。从土荅聲。
As per 余# (stretch) + an element combining 水 water and 土 earth → stretch in spreading coats of *mud* over a wall → *coat* → *paint*; *get muddy*.
泥也。从土涂聲。
As per 唐# (rise) + 土 earth → raised earth, in the form of a *dike* or *embankment*. *Pond* is by association with an earthen water tank.
隄也。从土唐聲。
高 here an abbreviated form# of 皜 (bleached highlands) + 土 earth → whitish, *hard earth* → *projecting part of a mountain*.
堅不可拔也。从土高聲。
土# pile of earth + the upper element of 寒 (pile construction elements in raising a shelter) → plug/fill holes in raising an earthen *fortress/fort* → *plug/dam up*; *stop (up)* → *fill*; *be filled*.
隔也。从土从𡨄。

As per 眞# (fullness) + 土 earth → *fill* a hole with earth → *go/fit into*; *cram*. Also, *put/pull on* (← fit gloves on one's hands), *ensnare* and *cheat* (← fall into a trap ← fill a hole). Note a variant form, 填.
塞也。从土眞聲。

鹿 (long herd of) deer + 土 earth → *dust* kicked up by an advancing herd of deer → *dirt* → *trash*; *waste*. As the Old Chinese pronunciation of 塵 matches that of 廛 (long strip), the two characters are graphically similar, and both involve long strings of objects, 塵 may be regarded as a variant and reinterpreted form of 廛.
As per 斬# (cut) + 土 earth → cut a *trench*, *ditch* or *moat* into the earth.
阬也。一曰大也。从土斬聲。
塵也。从土麻聲。
As per 專# (round and/or rotating object) + 土 earth → round (earthen) *tile*. Compare 甎.
As per 孰# (an enclosure) + 土 earth → an earthen structure → *private/cram school* (originally, one operated in such a structure).
門側堂也。从土孰聲。
As per 婁# (continuum) + 土 earth → *anthill* (built by a continuous procession of ants) → *small/low mound*.
塺土也。从土婁聲。
As per 犀# (slow) + 土 earth → *slope*/*steps* of a *courtyard* (causing progress to slow).
涂地也。从土犀聲。《禮》：“天子赤墀。”
As per 曼# (cover; be covered) + 土 earth → *plaster* a long earthen wall. *Trowel* is a borrowed meaning via 鏝.
As per 竟# (border) + 土 earth (for emphasis/clarification) → *border*; *boundary* → *area*. Also, *circumstances* (← situation in which one is fixed ← fixed border).
疆也。从土竟聲。經典通用竟。
野# field/plain + 土 earth → earthen structure in a field or on a plain → *shed*; *rest house* → *villa*. Also, *countryside* and *suburbs*.
擁也。从土章聲。
庸# work + 土 earth → work in making an earthen *wall*.
城垣也。从土庸聲。
下也。《春秋傳》曰：“墊隘。”从土執聲。
既 here an abbreviated form# of 概 level off + 土 earth → level off mud/*plaster* from a surface in construction → *paint* (a wall, a house etc.) → *exert oneself to the full*.
涂也。从土堇聲。
As per 莫# (concealed) + 土 earth → *grave/tomb* where the deceased are concealed.
丘也。从土莫聲。

entries.text: As per 隊# (collapse) + 土 earth → collapsing earth → *fall*. Devised to replace 隊 after the latter's transformation of meanings.
陊也。从土隊聲。古通用䃍。
As per 堯# (arch/rise high) + 土 earth → arching stretch of *land unsuitable for agriculture* on account of being overrun with stones. Compare 磽.
As per 曾# (pile) + 土 earth → pile earth → *pile up*; *add (to)*; *increase*; *gain*; *multiply* → *breed*; *extra*; *increasingly*; *more and more*.
益也。从土曾聲。
As per 虛# (sunken) + 土 earth → *ruins* that have sunk into the earth.
野土也。从土單聲。
塊也。从土菐聲。
As per 番# (spread) + 土 earth → spreading earthen mound → *grave*; *tomb*. Compare 墳.
黑# black (soot) + 土 earth → clods of soot → *ink block*; *India ink*. For soot, compare 煤.
書墨也。从土从黑，黑亦聲。
舞也。从士尊聲。《詩》曰：“墫墫舞我。”
As per 隋# (collapsing pile of earth) + 土 earth (for emphasis/clarification) → collapsing/falling earth → *fall*; *drop*.
As per 賁# (swell) + 土 earth → swelling/bulging earth of a *burial mound* or *tumulus*. Compare 墦.
墓也。从土賁聲。
間 gap/interval + 土 earth → *steep bluff*. Compare 圸 and 壗.
奧# deep + 土 earth → deeply recessed area of *land* (compare 隩). The *shore of an inlet* is a borrowed meaning, via 澳.
四方土可居也。从土奧聲。

entries.text: 瓴適也。一曰未燒也。从土毄聲。
磽也。从土敫聲。

貇 combines 艮 (adhere) with 豸 animal that ambles along the ground → teeth of a sharp-toothed beast adhering to an object or to the piece of food being gnawed → gnaw. 墾 is as per 貇# (adhere) + 土 earth → agricultural tool adhering to the soil in *cultivation*.
As per 辟# (spread) + 土 earth → spreading, earthen *wall*.
垣也。从土辟聲。
As per 雍# (contain) + 土 earth → earthen walls that wrap about and confine → *obstruct*; *block in/off*.
As per 亶# (long and flat) + 土 earth → long and flat, earthen altar → *platform*; *dais*; *rostrum*. Compare 禅.
祭場也。从土亶聲。
熏# smoke + 土 earth → *ancient wind instrument* resembling an ocarina, and made of fired earth (← dark color resulting from firing ← smoke).
樂器也。以土爲之，六孔。从土熏聲。
王者印也。所以主土。从土爾聲。
塵也。从土蓋聲。
As per 厭# (press upon) + 土 earth → *pressure* exerted on the earth by a heavy object → *press*.
壞也。一曰塞補。从土厭聲。
As per 壽# (ridge) + 土 earth → *furrows/ridges*. Also, long *embankment*. As with 疇, 壔 was devised to replace 壽 after 壽 came to indicate "longevity."
保也。高土也。从土𠷎聲。讀若毒。
As per 豪# (stretch at length) + 土 earth → *moat* stretching about an edifice. Compare 濠.
盡 here an abbreviated form of 儘 for the KUN reading まま + 土 earth → *steep bluff*. Compare 圸 and 墹.

畾# is 田 field (tripled). This element is a variant of one that added another 夕 element at the bottom left of 多 (tall, neat pile of meat). 壘 is 畾 (pile) + 土 earth → earth piled into a long/tall and winding *rampart* → (baseball) *base*.
軍壁也。从土畾聲。
As per 廣# (extend) + 土 earth → extensive *open wilderness* → *deserted*; *empty*; *hole*; *pit* → *grave*.
塹穴也。一曰大也。从土廣聲。
As per 盧# (sunken) + 土 earth → *black clod of dirt* partially sunken in the earth. *Earthenware cooking pot* is an atavistic meaning derived from the original full sense of 盧.
剛土也。从土盧聲。
As per 曇# (dense) + 土 earth → dense earthen container. *Bottle* is an associated meaning. Note a variant form 罎, which replaces 土 with 缶 bulging earthenware jug/vase.

As per 褱# as described in 懷 (fall and be absorbed) + 土 earth → collapsing pile of earth, absorbed by the ground (compare 崩, 隨 and 圮) → *collapse*; *destruction* → *pull/tear down*; *breakage*; *damage*; *injury*.
敗也。从土褱聲。
As per 龍# (winding) + 土 earth → winding *ridge* between fields → *mound*; *hill* (compare 隴) → *grave* (← burial mound).
丘壠也。从土龍聲。
As per 襄# (supple/soft) + 土 earth → softened *earth*/*soil*.
柔土也。从土襄聲。
As per 霸/覇# (spread) + 土 earth → spreading *embankment* (compare 坊 and 防) → *dam*.
A depiction of an erect object formed by small composite materials (compare 且). *Man* and *retainer* are associated meanings (← person standing erect), with *samurai* by extension.
事也。數始於一，終於十。从一从十。孔子曰：“推十合一爲士。”凡士之屬皆从士。
A depiction of a spool encompassed by soft, thick threads → *thick*. (Distinguish from the right-hand element of 廷.) *Ninth in a series* and *ninth calendar sign* are borrowed meanings.
位北方也。陰極陽生，故《易》曰：“龍戰于野。”戰者，接也。象人褢妊之形。承亥壬以子，生之敘也。與巫同意。壬承辛，象人脛。脛，任體也。凡壬之屬皆从壬。
As per 丬/爿# (long and slender) + 士 male → tall and neat male → *manhood*; *strength*.
大也。从士爿聲。
陳樂立而上見也。从屮从豆。凡壴之屬皆从壴。

The relevant seal inscription form is 壺 lidded pot + 吉# (filled container) → full pot/jar → *one* (← unity of contents). As with 弐, 参/參, and 拾, 壱 is used as a substitute for the usual number (in this case, 一) in documents as a precaution against forgery.
專壹也。从壺吉聲。凡壹之屬皆从壹。
A depiction of a lidded *vase* or *pot* → *jug*; *jar*. Also, *key point* and *vital point* (← ancient game in which the objective was to toss arrows into a jar).
昆吾圜器也。象形。从大，象其蓋也。凡壷之屬皆从壷。
夫也。从士胥聲。《詩》曰：“女也不爽，士貳其行。”士者，夫也。讀與細同。

An abbreviated form of 壹 (jar crammed full) + 亞# (downward pressure) → narrow-mouthed, wide-bodied *pot/container* (compare 罌) filled with heavy contents. *Inner garden of a palace* is a borrowed meaning, as are the minor meanings of *vital point* and *point on which one's places one's hopes/expectations*.

The relevant seal inscription form is an abbreviated form# of 老 (aged person) + ridges surrounding a paddy or field → aged person following a long, curved ridge about a paddy/field → *longevity*; *long span* (← length of an aged person's lifespan) → *congratulations* (← celebration of long life).
久也。从老省，𠷎聲。
